partial_overlap_method.transform: Unicode NFC then whitespace collapse only; retain case, punctuation, damaged signs, diacritics, and editorial characters. Equal text need not have equal meaning, edition, or object.
partial_overlap_method.unit: source field occurrence; duplicate view loci within a repository collapsed by path/pointer
partial_overlap_method.limits: Not semantic equivalence, fuzzy matching, cross-language translation matching, or exhaustive upstream source-history research. Short strings are deliberately omitted. Candidates may be translations, commentary or reused infrastructure; inspect each source role before deductions. No text payload redistributed.

boundary: All declared rows means all retrieval views at these eighteen checkpoints, including registers, hypotheses and repeated views. It is not all inscriptions, independent witnesses, verified readings or all source literature.
